column4: Mac calls drawSmackerFrame at code0+0x25e788 from videoDrawCurrentFrame and retains its body at code0+0x25f948. Its out-of-line Windows body links later at 0x598e80, so this exact VA inversion reflects retained helper emission rather than a misplaced definition.

The canonical ordinary bodies follow that caller in the shared TU so VC6 preserves the retail call boundaries; Windows links the helper emissions earlier at 0x4bc350/0x4bc5d0. Keep the source call shape and review this exact VA inversion.
